artifact_observations.reasoning: The blue device attached to the wheel center is structurally nonsensical. It appears to be a 'heart-shaped' clamp with a single thin rod extending horizontally to the right that does not connect to anything. Real wheel locks are symmetrical mechanical devices; this object looks like a hallucinated fusion of a padlock and a decorative shape, lacking functional mechanics.
The text on the tire sidewall is blurry and illegible, resembling gibberish rather than crisp brand lettering, which is a common AI artifact.
The curvature of the white fender arch seems slightly inconsistent with the perspective of the wheel, appearing somewhat flattened or oddly spaced from the tire top.
